response.description: The MSSQL extension now provides a guided local-to-cloud deployment experience for Azure SQL Database. You can move from a local Azure SQL Database container to the cloud directly from Visual Studio Code. The wizard supports schema-only or schema-and-data deployment, validates compatibility before deployment, and streamlines deployment to a new or existing Azure SQL Database.  Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code - local-to-cloud deployment wizard
